operating_rule: Run stages sequentially. Submit only after preflight and verified shutdown of the previous owned job. Check both clusters while queued, retain healthy allocations, never cancel another owner. Both matched comparisons stay on East. Each stage allows at most two actual submissions, counting failures; no silent or automatic retries.
limits: Separate control and async allocations do not share a training trajectory or justify pooling timing samples. Report their pins and controls separately. No learning or parameter-gradient benefit claim.
